rulings.item: ram-sweep and the warm copies: <ram>/claude/plants-warm/<role>/copy-<k> lives across runs; a sweep while a run holds copy-<k>.lock would break that run
rulings.recommendation: ram-sweep skips a plants-warm copy whose lock is held (flock -n fails) and may remove an idle one as any leftover (the next run is then cold)

rulings.item: Next step for the remaining baseline cost: NIJI_PLANTS_BUILD_TAG fixed per warm copy instead of plants-<pid> (early-cargo-ld/ldconfig/localedef rebuild every run, early-builds-wait 154 s)
